title: XYZTHIANS: The Internal, Interaction, and External Trinities
funding: Currently seeking funding and support to bring this project to life!
description:
The gods of the inner mind, born from the trauma of the American Civil War.

The Internal Trinity (The Foundation)

X: Xaeron (The Duality of Outcry)
The Vibe: Historical trauma, raw emotion, and the 'First Scream.'
The Artifact: An 'Evidence Locker' filled with redacted news clippings and found-poetry lyrics.

Y: Ytaeron (The Duality of Peace)
The Vibe: The 'Suffocation of Peace'—the moment where quiet becomes overwhelming.
The Artifact: A sensory journal with tactile fabrics and vellum pages that flutter like a breeze.

Z: Zotrexon (The Duality of Potential)
The Vibe: The stress of infinite choice. High-pressure potential that leads to paralysis.
The Artifact: A 'Gray Dictionary' of potential futures that dissolves into gibberish at the end.

The Interaction Trinity (The Convergence)
Where the Veil meets our modern, dystopian Earth.

T: Tenebraeum (The Duality of Revelation)
The Vibe: Gothic Noir. A mad-struck Washington D.C. seen through 'Black Mirrors.'
The Artifact: A cinematic manuscript using glossy paper and reflections to show 'The Unveiling.'

H: Helixotope (The Duality of Dimension)
The Vibe: The literal bridge between worlds. Grids, blueprints, and architectural order.
The Artifact: A technical manual using metallic inks and long-exposure photos of 'moving' guards.

I: Iantheos (The Duality of Devotion)
The Vibe: The Absolute Imperative of Will. The anchor that keeps you sane.
The Artifact: The 'Songbook of Resistance' featuring a hidden USB with your original music.

The External Trinity (The Deep Veil)
The creatures and worlds found deep within the Sandbox.

A: Alithianos (The Duality of Perception)
The Vibe: Alice in Wonderland meets Eldritch. A world made entirely of shifting Blue shades.
The Artifact: A surreal travelogue of a human negotiating with the 'Blue Queen' to return home.

N: Nymslyornt (The Duality of Mutastasis)
The Vibe: The Vibrant Tricksters (Fae). Creatures that 'stick like glue' if your energy is right.
The Artifact: A weathered 'Campfire Stories' scout manual filled with neon luring-colors.

S: Seititne (The Duality of Fragmented Truth)
The Vibe: The 'Misprints of Creation.' Void-dwelling monsters that spread the 7 Deadly Sins.
The Artifact: The Media Artifact—an embedded screen playing the 'Glitched Mockumentary.'

The Capstones
The two volumes that tie the 9 letters together.

Vol 10: XYZ (Everything and the Kitchen Sink)
The Purpose: The Lore Bible. The raw data, every scripture, and every sketch behind the 9 letters.

Vol 11: The Compendium
The Purpose: The Visual Masterpiece. Your professional global and space photography, proving the Xyzthians exist in our physical reality.
